subasaLLM.title: Subasa LLM Framework
subasaLLM.tech: PyTorch, HuggingFace, Transformers, TRL, Unsloth, Scikit-learn, LoRA
subasaLLM.shortDescription: A task-specific fine-tuning framework for LLMs focused on offensive language detection.
subasaLLM.description: This project provides a specialized fine-tuning pipeline for large language models (including Llama and Mistral variants) using LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) to optimize model performance on offensive language detection tasks across multilingual contexts. It features comprehensive support for the Sinhala language, integrating seamlessly with the SOLD (Sinhala Offensive Language Detection) benchmark for evaluation.
features: Sinhala offensive language detection
Support for multiple LLM architectures (Llama, Mistral)
LoRA-based fine-tuning for efficient training
Offensive phrase extraction and analysis
Integration with Weights & Biases for experiment tracking
Support for both standard and augmented datasets
Comprehensive evaluation metrics and reporting
Advanced data augmentation strategies

subasaPLM.title: Subasa - Pretrained Language Models (PLM) Framework
subasaPLM.shortDescription: A framework for adapting Pretrained Language Models for Low-Resourced Offensive Language Detection in Sinhala using pretrained models and intermediate tasks.
subasaPLM.description: A framework for adapting Pretrained Language Models for Low-Resourced Offensive Language Detection in Sinhala using pretrained models and intermediate tasks.
features: Two-stage finetuning approach with intermediate tasks
Support for multiple pretrained models (XLM-RoBERTa base/large)
Intermediate tasks: Masked Rationale Prediction (MRP) and Rationale Prediction (RP)
Comprehensive evaluation metrics including AUROC and explainability measures
Integration with Weights & Biases for experiment tracking
LIME-based model explanations

personacraftAI.title: PersonaCraft.AI
personacraftAI.category: Natural Language Processing, Machine Learning, LLMOps
personacraftAI.tech: Python, FastAPI, ZenML, LangChain, MongoDB, Qdrant, OpenAI GPT-4, Llama 3.1, TRL, Unsloth, AWS SageMaker, Docker
personacraftAI.shortDescription: A comprehensive ML platform that transforms digital content into high-quality instruction and preference datasets for AI model training.
personacraftAI.description: PersonaCraft.AI is a comprehensive machine learning platform that crawls, processes, and transforms digital content from various sources into high-quality instruction and preference datasets for training AI models. The system creates personalized AI training data by analyzing an individual's digital footprint across multiple platforms, featuring a modular pipeline-based architecture with MLOps integration.
features: Multi-platform data crawling (LinkedIn, Medium, GitHub, web articles)
Intelligent data processing with text cleaning and embedding generation
Instruction-following and preference dataset generation using GPT models
Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
ZenML-based MLOps pipeline for reproducible workflows
Qdrant vector database integration for similarity search
MongoDB data warehouse for structured storage
AWS SageMaker integration for scalable cloud training
Automated Hugging Face Hub publishing
Selenium-based web scraping with BeautifulSoup4
Docker containerization and Poetry package management
Comet ML and Opik monitoring integration

realtimeFashionRecommender.title: Realtime Fashion Recommender
realtimeFashionRecommender.tech: TensorFlow, CatBoost, Hopsworks, Streamlit, Python, Keras, MLOps
realtimeFashionRecommender.shortDescription: A machine learning-powered fashion recommendation system with real-time inference and interactive customer experiences.
realtimeFashionRecommender.description: A machine learning-powered fashion recommendation system built with TensorFlow Recommenders and Hopsworks, featuring real-time inference and interactive customer experiences. This project implements a two-tower retrieval model combined with a ranking model to provide personalized fashion recommendations based on H&M customer data.
features: Real-time personalized fashion item recommendations with real-time inference
Two-tower architecture with customer and item embedding towers for efficient candidate retrieval
CatBoost ranking model for ranking and reordering recommended items
Interactive Streamlit-based web interface for customer interaction and feedback
Complete MLOps pipeline with feature engineering, training, and deployment using Hopsworks
Real-time feature store to track customer interactions and update recommendations dynamically
Customer tower encoding customer features (age, membership status, interaction history)
Item tower encoding article features (garment type, color, department, embeddings)
TensorFlow/Keras architecture with embedding layers and feed-forward networks
Customer demographics, item attributes, and interaction patterns analysis
